item.title: Winnsboro admins arrested again
item.description: WINNSBORO – On Thursday morning, two WISD school administrators who were previously charged with concealing numerous child abuse incidents were arrested again on new charges. item.title: Hutchins city leaders meet to discuss ICE detention center as residents continue opposition
item.description: HUTCHINS – Hutchins city leaders met briefly Wednesday to discuss a proposed immigration facility as residents and local lawmakers gathered to oppose it, according to KERA. item.title: Savannah Guthrie’s missing mother is ‘still out there,’ sheriff says, but no suspects
item.description: Investigators have no proof that the missing mother of “Today” show host Savannah Guthrie is still alive but are holding out hope she’s “still out there,” a sheriff in Arizona said Thursday.
